name: zinterp_context_next_token
description: zInterp_Context::NextToken advances the interpreter token read cursor and returns the next macro-expanded token.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInterp parser/runtime source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4c1990 validates tokenReadIndex load and increment, unsigned tokenCount bounds check, null-token return, and tail call to ExpandMacroRefs for non-null tokens.
The native smoke verifies ordinary token return, macro-expanded token return, past-end cursor advancement, and null token slot behavior.
